statuses.reason: paths./donation-categories: GET takes only query, start_page and how_many, and POST takes only a name. Neither names an object in its path, query or body, so there is nothing that can be missing.

The path and body name no object. The id parameters are list filters (category_id, donation_page, fundraising_campaign, association_campaign_target, payment_settings_id and bank_account_id on /donations and /donations/micro, category_id and payment_settings_id on /donation-pages and /donation-forms). The only documented behavior for an id filter naming no object is paths./debts.get debt_category_id: 'Another organisation's id matches nothing'. An unknown id therefore returns an empty list, not 404.

properties.reason: paths./donations/micro.get query list: the enum leaves out the four marketing_channel__utm_* values that GET /donations offers, and those fields appear only when list asks for them (the rule paths./ecard-transactions.get documents), so a micro donation row can never carry them.
